title: Royal Flame premium restaurant homepage (responsive, conversion-focused)

requirements.text: Implement a single-page, section-based homepage for “Royal Flame” with anchor navigation and the following sections in order: Hero, About, Featured Menu, Why Choose Us, Gallery, Testimonials, Reservations, Location, Footer.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders as a single scrolling page with all 10 requested sections present and visually separated.
Navbar links scroll to the correct section IDs (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Reservations, Contact).

requirements.text: Create a sticky top navbar with a left-aligned Royal Flame logo, menu links (Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Reservations, Contact), and a right-aligned gold-accent “Reservation” button.

quotes:
1. Sticky Navbar
Logo on left
Menu links: Home, Menu, About, Gallery, Reservations, Contact
Right side reservation button (gold accent)

acceptanceCriteria: Navbar stays visible at the top while scrolling.
Reservation button uses gold highlight styling and stands out from the text links.
On mobile, navigation remains usable (e.g., collapses into a menu/drawer).

requirements.text: Implement the full-width Hero section using a high-quality restaurant interior background image with a dark gradient overlay, heading text “Experience Fine Dining Like Never Before”, an emotional subheading tagline, and two CTAs: “Reserve a Table” (primary gold button) and “View Menu” (outline style).

quotes:
2. Hero Section (Full Width)
Large high-quality restaurant interior background image
Overlay dark gradient
Heading: "Experience Fine Dining Like Never Before"
Subheading: Short emotional tagline
CTA Buttons:
- Reserve a Table (primary gold button)
- View Menu (outline style)

acceptanceCriteria: Hero background image is full-width with an overlay gradient to maintain text legibility.
Hero renders exactly the specified heading text.
Two CTA buttons are present with distinct primary/outline styling.
“Reserve a Table” scrolls to the Reservations section; “View Menu” scrolls to Featured Menu.

requirements.text: Implement the About section as a split layout: left side image, right side a short story paragraph plus three highlight items: Fresh Ingredients, Award Winning Chefs, Cozy Atmosphere.

quotes:
3. About Section (Split Layout)
Left: Restaurant image
Right: Story of the restaurant (short paragraph)
Include 3 highlights:
- Fresh Ingredients
- Award Winning Chefs
- Cozy Atmosphere

acceptanceCriteria: About section uses a two-column layout on desktop and stacks cleanly on mobile.
All three highlight items are displayed and readable.

requirements.text: Implement a Featured Menu section showing exactly 6 food items in a responsive grid; each card includes a food image, name, short description, and price, with a soft shadow hover effect.

quotes:
4. Featured Menu Section
Display 6 food items in grid layout
Each card:
- Food image
- Name
- Short description
- Price
Hover effect with soft shadow

acceptanceCriteria: Exactly 6 menu cards appear.
Each menu card contains image, title, description, and price.
Hover state adds a subtle premium shadow and/or lift effect (where hover is available).

requirements.text: Implement a “Why Choose Us” section with 4 icon-based features: Premium Quality, Live BBQ, Private Dining Rooms, Fast Service.

quotes:
5. Why Choose Us Section
Icon-based 4 features:
- Premium Quality
- Live BBQ
- Private Dining Rooms
- Fast Service

acceptanceCriteria: All four features are displayed with icons and labels.
Layout is responsive and maintains consistent spacing/alignment.

requirements.text: Implement a Gallery section as a responsive grid of food and interior images with a lightbox preview effect (open image in an overlay with next/previous controls and close).

quotes:
6. Gallery Section
Grid of food and interior images
Lightbox preview effect

acceptanceCriteria: Gallery displays a grid of images.
Clicking an image opens a lightbox overlay.
User can close the lightbox and navigate between images in the overlay.

requirements.text: Implement a Testimonials section with centered card layout showing customer review text and a star rating for each testimonial.

quotes:
7. Testimonials Section
Customer reviews with star rating
Centered card layout

acceptanceCriteria: Each testimonial shows review text and a visible star rating.
Testimonials are presented in a centered, premium-looking card layout and remain readable on mobile.

requirements.text: Implement a Reservations section containing a booking form with fields: Name, Phone, Date, Time, Guests, and a gold-accent “Reserve” button; include basic client-side validation and a clear success state after submit.

quotes:
8. Reservation Section
Simple booking form:
- Name
- Phone
- Date
- Time
- Guests
Reserve button (gold accent)

acceptanceCriteria: Form contains exactly the requested fields and a Reserve button.
Invalid submissions are blocked with inline validation feedback (e.g., required fields).
On successful submit, the user sees a confirmation message/state without a page reload.

requirements.text: Implement a Location section with an embedded map placeholder area plus address and contact information presented clearly.

quotes:
9. Location Section
Embedded map placeholder
Address and contact info

acceptanceCriteria: A map placeholder block is visible and sized appropriately for desktop and mobile.
Address and contact info are displayed adjacent to or below the map placeholder.

requirements.text: Implement a Footer with 4 columns: About, Quick Links, Opening Hours, Social Media.

quotes:
10. Footer
4 columns:
- About
- Quick Links
- Opening Hours
- Social Media

acceptanceCriteria: Footer contains four distinct columns with the requested headings.
On mobile, footer columns stack in a readable order with consistent spacing.

requirements.text: Apply the specified brand style across the page: elegant/warm/minimal luxury; cream/white backgrounds, dark brown accents, gold highlights; elegant serif for headings and clean sans-serif for body; modern spacing, soft shadows, and smooth scrolling behavior.

quotes:
Style: Elegant, warm, luxurious but minimal
Color Scheme: Cream / white background, dark brown accents, gold highlights
Typography: Elegant serif heading font + clean sans-serif body font
Design Requirements:
- Fully responsive
- Modern spacing
- Soft shadows
- Smooth scroll animation
- Clean professional layout
- High-resolution UI mockup
- Conversion focused design

acceptanceCriteria: Global color palette reflects cream/white + dark brown + gold accent (no default/unstyled theme).
Headings use a serif font and body text uses a sans-serif font consistently.
Smooth scrolling is enabled for in-page navigation.
All sections are responsive with consistent spacing and premium-feeling shadows on cards/buttons where appropriate.

requirements.text: Add and use generated static image assets for the hero, about, featured menu items, gallery, and a simple Royal Flame logo, stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced directly from the frontend.

quotes: Large high-quality restaurant interior background image
Display 6 food items in grid layout
Grid of food and interior images

acceptanceCriteria: All required images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated and load correctly in the UI.
Hero, About, Menu cards, and Gallery render using the generated images rather than broken links or empty placeholders.
Logo is displayed in the navbar using a generated image asset.

constraints: Frontend must not modify files in the immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose read-only UI components rather than editing them).
Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister if backend work is later added.
nonGoals: Implementing real map integration (use an embedded map placeholder only).
Implementing third-party booking integrations, payments, or external databases.
Implementing multi-page routing beyond the single-page section-based homepage (unless required by the template).
